sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: [LOGIC] gen:TRF_042_PlatingShape/sh:sparql[1] and nltl:hullStructuralSteelGrade/sh:in: The candidate does not support the requirement's provision for steels with different yield stresses whose actual accepted yield-stress values may be substituted: every listed normal-strength grade is forced to exactly 235 MPa, every listed high-strength grade is forced to at least 315 MPa, and sh:in prevents identifying any other steel grade. rows: [MANDATORY_CONDITION] MainShape > nltl:corrosionAbrasionAddition: The corrosion and abrasion addition has only sh:maxCount 1 and no sh:minCount, so it may be omitted entirely; omission bypasses both the normal 2 mm requirement and the conditional approval/coating requirement for a lower value. Required change: Add sh:minCount 1 to require exactly one corrosionAbrasionAddition quantity. | [DATATYPE_QUANTITY_ACCESS] MainShape SPARQL constraint for nltl:materialApprovalStatus: The conditional check only requires one materialApprovalStatus value to be typed nltl:evidenceState and equal to Approved; it does not constrain all supplied materialApprovalStatus values to the canonical evidenceState range when lower corrosion addition is used. Required change: Add a property constraint or equivalent conditional validation requiring every materialApprovalStatus value in the lower-addition case to be an instance of nltl:evidenceState, while retaining the required Approved value.

[OMITTED_OBLIGATORY_ELEMENT] gen:TRF_042_PlatingShape: The requirement explicitly requires yield strength sigma_y as yieldStrength_MPa, including the normal-strength, high-strength, and accepted substituted-value cases, but the candidate provides no yieldStrength input or constraint. Required change: Add the canonical nltl:yieldStrength quantity input in MPa and encode the applicable yield-strength/value relationship, including the permitted normal-strength and high-strength cases or accepted substituted values. | [LOGIC] gen:TRF_042_PlatingShape/sh:sparql[2]: For a lower-than-2 mm corrosion addition, the query only requires that an approved status exists and rejects untyped statuses; it nevertheless accepts multiple status values containing both Approved and a typed non-approved state, so the material approval status is not actually constrained to Approved. Required change: Require exactly one canonical materialApprovalStatus value, nltl:evidenceStateApproved, or otherwise reject every supplied status that is not the canonical Approved evidence state when tc is below 2 mm.

[LOGIC] MainShape/sh:sparql[1]: The yield-strength constraint does not enforce the required 235 MPa value for normal-strength hull structural steel, including nltl:normalStrengthHullStructuralSteel and the normal-strength grades nltl:steelGradeB, nltl:steelGradeD, and nltl:steelGradeE; any positive value currently passes. Required change: Add a normal-strength branch rejecting yield values other than 235 MPa, while separately permitting only explicitly represented accepted substitutions if those are supported by the model.

[LOGIC] gen:TRF_042_PlatingShape/sh:sparql[1] and nltl:hullStructuralSteelGrade/sh:in: The candidate does not support the requirement's provision for steels with different yield stresses whose actual accepted yield-stress values may be substituted: every listed normal-strength grade is forced to exactly 235 MPa, every listed high-strength grade is forced to at least 315 MPa, and sh:in prevents identifying any other steel grade.
